hooks.name: Check thresholds after a value change
hooks.description: After a save to thresholds.py, ask the agent to run the threshold tests and remind that a changed value needs a new decision record. Enforced for real by tests and pre-commit.

action.prompt: src/computers/thresholds.py was just saved. Run `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_thresholds.py -q` and `uv run computers thresholds check`. If a value changed, a new decision file is needed in docs/decisions/ with the numbers behind the change, and docs/decisions/thresholds.lock.json must point at it. Do not reuse the previous decision file for a changed value.
